description: This PHP source file defines the ResourceIdentifierNormalizer class, which normalizes and denormalizes JSON:API resource identifiers and relationships within Drupal's JSON:API module. It handles serialization, validation, and processing of relationship data according to the JSON:API specification.

classes.name: ResourceIdentifierNormalizer
classes.description: A normalizer class for JSON:API resource identifiers and relationships, implementing normalization and denormalization logic, including validation and handling of relationship data.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Serializes a ResourceIdentifier object into an array or scalar suitable for JSON output, including optional meta data.

methods.name: denormalize
methods.description: Converts input data into ResourceIdentifier objects, validating types and ensuring uniqueness, used during JSON:API relationship POST/PATCH requests.

methods.name: massageRelationshipInput
methods.description: Validates and adjusts relationship input data based on whether the relationship is to-one or to-many.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Returns an array indicating that this normalizer supports ResourceIdentifier class.
